P1.1.text: Invested in the long run | Diamond Hill

P1.2.text: At Diamond Hill, a First Eagle Investments company, we are fiercely committed to generating excellent, long-term investment outcomes and building enduring client partnerships

P1.3.text: We have been made aware that individuals are impersonating Diamond Hill employees on WhatsApp. These impersonators may attempt to gather your personal information or engage in fraudulent activities.

P1.4.text: Examples include a WhatsApp group promoting a free trial membership for investment courses offered by a member of our investment team.

P1.5.text: Please note, Diamond Hill does not provide subscription-based investment courses or investment advice. Diamond Hill does not contact clients or potential clients over WhatsApp, text messages, or from free email addresses such as Yahoo or Gmail. Diamond Hill will not ask for sensitive passwords, financial details or personal identification through WhatsApp.

P1.6.text: Diamond Hill is not responsible for any services or information offered by or provided to unauthorized parties. If you think you or someone you know has been a victim of fraud, please report the matter to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) at https://www.ic3.gov/, police or other relevant authorities.

P1.7.text: To block a scammer or suspected scammer on WhatsApp:

P1.8.text: Open the chat with the scammer

P1.10.text: If you want to report a suspected scammer:

P1.11.text: Select the three dots in the bottom right corner

P1.12.text: Check the Block and Delete box

P1.13.text: For more on how we protect our clients’ personal information, refer to our privacy policy.

P1.17.text: We are fiercely committed to generating excellent, long-term investment outcomes and building enduring client partnerships.

P1.18.text: We offer a variety of investment strategies in four key asset classes.

P1.19.text: Five investment principles inform our decision-making across asset classes and are the foundation for outstanding long-term investment results.

P1.20.text: Subscribe to our insights to stay on top of your favorite topics.

P2.2.text: We are fiercely committed to generating excellent, long-term investment outcomes and building enduring partnerships. We accomplish this through our shared investment principles and client alignment philosophy.

P2.4.text: At Diamond Hill, a First Eagle Investments company, we are fiercely committed to generating excellent, long-term investment outcomes and building enduring partnerships. We accomplish this through our shared investment principles and client alignment philosophy.

P2.5.text: Our shared investment principles align our investment professionals across multiple capabilities, are foundational to how we invest and support our aim of generating excellent long-term investment results.

P2.6.text: An active, research-driven approach that capitalizes on our intellectual curiosity and unique insights is essential to deliver better returns than benchmarks or peers.

P2.7.text: Investing with an ownership mentality requires deep due diligence to build the conviction needed to invest over the long term.

P2.8.text: Focusing on the long term allows us to look beyond near-term noise, allowing clients to realize the benefits of our deep, disciplined research process.

P2.9.text: We believe the best way to compound returns is to take an ownership stake in an investment at a discount to its underlying value and have the discipline to wait for that value to be realized.

P2.10.text: Prudent capacity management protects our ability to generate competitive long-term investment results for our clients.

P2.11.text: We build long-term partnerships by aligning our interests with those of our clients. This philosophy ensures our clients' best interests come first.

P2.12.text: Clients benefit when we keep asset levels in check

P2.13.text: Greater assets under management (AUM) lead to higher revenue for managers but can negatively impact existing clients' performance. Our portfolio managers are incentivized to close strategies to protect their ability to generate excess returns.

P1.3.text: Hello, you are using an old browser that's unsafe and no longer supported. Please consider updating your browser to a newer version, or downloading a modern browser.

P1.4.text: For over twenty years, Silvercrest has proudly served Individuals and Families, Institutional Investors, and Endowments & Foundations.

P1.6.text: Silvercrest: A Firm Committed to Excellence

P1.7.text: Our goal is to provide unparalleled advice to every client. Alongside our modern approach to portfolio construction, we offer the personalized service and open communication larger organizations can't, so clients feel confident and secure in choosing Silvercrest.

P1.8.text: Since our founding we have proudly served individuals and families with significant financial assets.

P1.9.text: Asset management is in our name. For over a decade, Silvercrest has partnered with select institutional clients to provide asset management, through our proprietary long-only equity management capabilities. We manage small through large cap value and growth equity, and international value strategies.

P1.10.text: Silvercrest partners with endowments, foundations and family offices to provide customized, full-service investment office solutions. The firm’s outsourced chief investment officer (OCIO) team leverages decades of experience managing nonprofits and family offices in tailoring portfolios to its clients’ distinctive financial goals, risk tolerances and mission objectives.

P1.11.text: In this issue of Insights, our team explores some of the most consequential forces shaping today’s markets and economy: the structure of the AI buildout, the philosophy of portfolio construction, and the geopolitical shifts reshaping how capital is deployed around the world.

P1.12.text: Same Question, Different Answer: Probabilistic AI in the Enterprise

P2.1.text: About Us | Silvercrest Asset Management Group

P2.2.text: Silvercrest is a firm of talented financial service advisors who provide fresh thinking to the management needs of our clients and firm.

P2.3.text: Silvercrest is a pioneer in the wealth management industry, setting the highest standards for independent investment advice and related family office services.

P2.4.text: We will always place our clients' needs first.

P2.5.text: We offer our individual and family clients robust investment capabilities trusted by sophisticated institutions.

P2.6.text: We tailor solutions to each client's goals.

P2.7.text: We provide a comprehensive family office solution, leveraging our deep expertise in tax, estate, philanthropic, and concierge services.

P2.8.text: We integrate world-class proprietary portfolio risk analytics and reporting.

P2.9.text: Clients choose Silvercrest for our integrity, consistency, and proven record of success.

P2.10.text: At Silvercrest, we’ve built a team of talented financial advisors who provide unwavering service to our clients according to their goals. We listen, we ask questions, and once we know exactly what you want, we apply our deep financial expertise to help you meet those goals.

P3.1.text: Endowments & Foundations | Silvercrest Asset Management Group

P3.2.text: We offer outsourced chief investment office solutions to foundations, endowments & institutions with long term investment time horizons.

P3.3.text: A Trusted Partner for Endowments & Foundations

P3.5.text: Silvercrest offers outsourced chief investment officer (“OCIO”) solutions to foundations, endowments and other institutions with long term investment time horizons.

P3.6.text: Understanding a client’s true risk tolerance is essential, as the primary risk is always a portfolio decline that leads to panicked selling and which can prevent the institution from achieving its long-term mission. Our team’s process focuses on understanding each client’s mission and long-term financial objective along with its portfolio preferences regarding risk, return, complexity, liquidity, mission-alignment and cost. The next step is to create a fully customized asset allocation and manager line-up that can achieve those goals and objectives in the most streamlined and cost-effective manner possible.

P3.7.text: The time tested strategy of portfolio diversification continues to be an important principle for any portfolio, whether a university endowment or a family foundation.

P3.8.text: How Fund Structure Shapes Outcomes: A Practical Guide
